description: Delta-neutral carry trade (funding arbitrage) analysis, with a profitable/marginal/loss verdict on top of the same math primitive.funding_arb uses. Compared with primitive.funding_arb, this one adds output for the case where a plain-English verdict is wanted, not just the raw numbers. Edge cases: notional and hold_days above zero; funding_rate_long and funding_rate_short are in PERCENT per interval (0.01 means 0.01%), either sign; transfer_fee_pct 0 or more, one way (default 0.1); interval_hours 0.25 to 24 (default 8), one interval for both legs. Not covered: price divergence between the two venues, liquidation of either leg, margin needed on both venues, rates that change during the hold, and withdrawal limits; the result assumes the rates stay as given. Use when user asks "is this carry trade worth it?": long on exchange A, short on exchange B, collect the funding rate spread. Returns: netYieldPct, grossProfit, netProfit, breakevenDays, verdict (profitable/marginal/loss).

funding_rate_long.description: Funding rate on the long exchange per interval, in percent (0.01 means 0.01%, not 0.0001)

funding_rate_short.description: Funding rate on the short exchange per interval, in percent (0.01 means 0.01%, not 0.0001)

interval_hours.description: Hours between funding payments, one interval for both legs (default 8; 1 for hourly venues; 4 or 2 on some symbols). A leg paid on another interval is entered as its rate times (this interval / its own interval).
